text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams focus on what really matters. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, the actual products or results you promise to produce, should be clearly stated from the beginning. Finally, stakeholder alignment means making sure everyone involved agrees on the goals and expectations. When all these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and everyone knows what they are working towards.
